sentences.text: Jon Snow is a fictional character in the A Song of Ice and Fire series of fantasy novels by American author George R. R. Martin , and its television adaptation Game of Thrones .	A Song of Ice and Fire	A Song of Ice and Fire	Game of Thrones	Game of Thrones	George R. R. Martin	George R. R. Martin	fictional character	fictional character	fantasy	fantasy

He is a prominent point of view character in the novels , and has been called one of the author 's `` finest creations '' and most popular characters by The New York Times .	point of view	Narration#Third-person, subjective	The New York Times	The New York Times
Jon is a main character in the TV series , and his storyline in the 2015 season 5 finale generated a strong reaction among viewers .	season 5	Game of Thrones (season 5)
Speculation about the character 's parentage has also been a popular topic of discussion among fans of both the books and the TV series .

Jon is introduced in 1996 's A Game of Thrones as the illegitimate son of Ned Stark , the honorable lord of Winterfell , an ancient fortress in the North of the fictional kingdom of Westeros .	Game of Thrones	Game of Thrones	A Game of Thrones	A Game of Thrones	Ned Stark	Ned Stark	Winterfell	Winterfell	the North	the North (A Song of Ice and Fire)	Westeros	Westeros

Knowing his prospects are limited by his status , Jon joins the Night 's Watch , who guard the far northern borders from the wildlings who live beyond The Wall .	wildlings	wildlings	The Wall	The Wall (A Song of Ice and Fire)
As the rest of the Starks face grave adversity , Jon finds himself honor bound to remain with the Watch .

In A Clash of Kings -LRB- 1998 -RRB- , he joins a scouting party investigating the growing threat from the otherworldly `` Others '' beyond the Wall , and manages to infiltrate the wildlings .	wildlings	wildlings	A Clash of Kings	A Clash of Kings	Others	Others (A Song of Ice and Fire)

Jon learns of their plans to invade Westeros in A Storm of Swords -LRB- 2000 -RRB- , and begins to fall in love with the fierce wildling woman Ygritte .	Ygritte	Ygritte	Westeros	Westeros	A Storm of Swords	A Storm of Swords
He betrays them -- and Ygritte -- before they can attack , but the Night Watch 's victory comes at a heavy price for Jon .	Ygritte	Ygritte
Now the Lord Commander of the Watch , he appears briefly in 2005 's A Feast for Crows .	A Feast for Crows	A Feast for Crows

Jon returns as a prominent character in a A Dance with Dragons -LRB- 2011 -RRB- , working to negotiate an alliance between the Night 's Watch and the wildlings .	A Dance with Dragons	A Dance with Dragons	wildlings	wildlings
The growing animosity he has attracted from among the Watch finally catches up with him , and he is forced to face the dire consequences .
Jon is portrayed by Kit Harington on the HBO series Game of Thrones .	Kit Harington	Kit Harington	Game of Thrones	Game of Thrones	HBO	HBO

His storyline follows the character 's plot arc from the novel series , though season 6 of the TV adaptation continued on from the events of Martin 's latest published installment .	season 6	Game of Thrones (season 6)

Harington was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Drama Series for the role in 2016 .	Primetime Emmy Award	Primetime Emmy Award	Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Drama Series	Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Drama Series

He was also nominated for a Saturn Award for Best Supporting Actor on Television in 2012 and 2016 .	Saturn Award	Saturn Award	Best Supporting Actor on Television	Saturn Award for Best Supporting Actor on Television

He and the rest of the cast were nominated for Screen Actors Guild Awards for Outstanding Performance by an Ensemble in a Drama Series in 2012 , 2014 , 2015 and 2016 .	Outstanding Performance by an Ensemble in a Drama Series	Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Performance by an Ensemble in a Drama Series
